scope: PUSH and CLIMB low-level policy optimization, evaluation, and provenance only

checkpoint_contract.init_checkpoint: loads actor and critic but resets optimizer and iteration
checkpoint_contract.resume: requires staging the checkpoint in logs/rsl_rl/<experiment>/<run>

acceptance_gate.native: two independent 32-episode groups, each at least 30 successful episodes
acceptance_gate.mujoco: two independent 32-episode groups, each at least 30 successful episodes
acceptance_gate.hardware: separate staged validation after both simulator gates pass
